text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This summer, we would hold a "training 
camp" for the Shuntaisai 
while commuting back and forth to the 
summer training camp grounds.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
All the equipment and staff are prepared. 
We should be able to accommodate your 
requests to the utmost.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Do you have any other questions, 
Shinkoma-sama, Trainer-sama?
choice_data_list: There is one thing I'd like to ask.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if humans weren't involved 
in the ancient Umamusume festivals,

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—if the form of those festivals changed 
because of some turning point,

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but feel now that it was 
because humans were there, 
because of a bond that tied humans and 
Umamusume deeply together.
choice_data_list:
Please tell us why humans began 
participating in the sacred rituals.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
......I have received your inquiry. 
Please give me a little time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our second training camp toward 
the 
Goshiki Shuntaisai began.
